types.name: Message
types.doc: One conversation message row (parts nested).

types.name: Part
types.doc: A typed message part: text, reasoning, tool call, tool result or summary.

types.name: ToolResultBody
types.doc: Bounded tool result: excerpt, exit code, artifact pointer and slice hint.

types.name: PageMeta
types.doc: Additive paging metadata: applied size, next cursor, has_more, total estimate.

types.name: MessagesPage
types.doc: One bounded page of conversation messages.

types.name: SessionState
types.doc: The durable session state projection.

types.name: AgentStateView
types.doc: The agent state machine view folded into a session state row.

types.name: AttachmentId
types.doc: One durable typed binary attachment: BLAKE3 digest (64 lowercase hex), mime, optional original filename and decompressed size. Decoders ignore unknown fields (the native additive-response contract); the daemon's own request DTO rejects them.

types.name: AttachmentRef
types.doc: One durable attachment REFERENCE (native additive-response contract): the surrogate reference id the retrieval routes address, plus the CAS digest and the exact presentation metadata (mime, optional filename, decompressed size). Decoders ignore unknown fields.

types.name: AttachmentUpload
types.doc: Strict request body of POST /native/session/{id}/attachments: canonical standard base64 bytes plus the declared mime.

types.name: TaskRun
types.doc: One durable task run projection (native task-run list/state reads; additive: decoders ignore unknown fields).

types.name: TaskRunStarted
types.doc: Response of a native task-run start: the durable run identity and its current state (additive: unknown fields ignored).

types.name: TaskRunCancelled
types.doc: Response of a native task-run cancel (additive: unknown fields ignored).

types.name: TaskRunWorkItem
types.doc: One wire work item of a native task-run start (the orchestrator's own JSON vocabulary).

types.name: TaskRunStartRequest
types.doc: Strict request body of POST /native/session/{id}/task-runs. The daemon validates every member strictly; money accepts a decimal string or a lossless JSON integer and is documented as json here. `submission_id` is the required client submission UUID of the logical start (idempotency key: a repeated key replays the original run receipt byte-for-byte).

types.name: SessionPromptRequest
types.doc: Strict request body of POST /native/session/{id}/prompt. `submission_id` is the required client submission UUID of the logical prompt (idempotency key: a repeated key with the equal normalized body returns the original receipt byte-for-byte; a different body under the same key is a typed conflict). The daemon validates every member strictly (`deny_unknown_fields`; an unknown field or typo is a 400).

types.name: SessionPromptReceipt
types.doc: Response of a native prompt: the accepted in-session run identity and queued flag (additive: unknown fields ignored). A submission-keyed replay returns the stored receipt byte-for-byte.

types.name: OutcomeMetrics
types.doc: The Engineering Outcome Ledger's first-class aggregate metrics plus the fold's scan honesty (`scanned` / `truncated`). Money fields are decimal strings (`*Micro`) — or null when the fact is not settled: `avoidedHostedInferenceMicro` is null with `avoidedHostedInferenceMeasurement = "unavailable"` unless at least one run carried a MEASURED counterfactual (zero is only a measured zero). Monetary metrics fold only `moneyCompleteRuns`; `moneyPendingRuns` / `moneyUnavailableRuns` are excluded and counted by `moneyIncompleteExcluded`, and `verifiedChangesMoneyComplete` is the shared Successful-Run-Cost/VCSC denominator (a client must gate BOTH cost values on it, never render its empty-denominator zero). Every rate carries its served denominator so an empty denominator renders as not-measured, never a measured 0: `localOnlyRuns`, `localFinalRuns`, `localFirstRuns`, `runsWithSteps` (the Hosted-Only Rate denominator: runs with at least one model step, `hostedOnlyRuns` / `runsWithSteps`), `runs`, `checksRequired`, and `totalSpendMicro` (Rework Cost Ratio); the Frontier Escalation Rate is null unless durable execution-class authority exists and its `measured` state folds over `runs` while `partial` folds over `frontierClassedRuns` (`frontierEscalationClassedRuns` / `frontierClassedRuns`). `verifiedFirstVerificationPassChanges` / `verifiedFirstVerificationPassPpm` are the Verified First Verification Pass Rate: verified changes whose FIRST VERIFICATION attempt passed — a verification-attempt measure, never an implementation-attempt claim. `localToHostedFallback*` is the Local-to-Hosted Fallback Rate and `hostedOnly*` the Hosted-Only Rate; both classify steps by the durable `executionClass` only. `frontierEscalationMeasurement` reports `measured` | `partial` | `unmeasured`. Local classification coverage mirrors that rule: `localMeasurement` reports `measured` | `partial` | `unmeasured` with the boundary-classed cohort in `localClassedRuns` (the boundary-derived local cohorts can only classify runs inside it — a folded display sequence never silently depresses them). `attributionCompleteRuns` / `attributionPartialRuns` / `attributionUnavailableRuns` count the recorded provider/model attribution honesty; `attributionIncompleteExcluded` (partial + unavailable) is the routing-learning feed exclusion count — a non-complete run never fed the ledger's atomic feed (its samples kept the per-call feed, never dropped).

types.name: RunOutcomeModelStep
types.doc: One provider/model step of a completed run's execution sequence. `executionClass` is the durable route-time classification (`local` | `hosted_economy` | `hosted_balanced` | `frontier` | `unknown`); `local` is CLASS-DERIVED — true only when the class is `local`. A step with no durable class authority (`unknown`: a pre-class legacy payload or an unpriced path) exposes its recorded pre-class local bit as `legacyLocal` (true only for a classless step whose stored row recorded a local execution); a class-carrying step always reports `legacyLocal` false, and the legacy bit is never promoted to a class claim. `unknown` is counted as neither local nor hosted by the metrics. `spendMicro` is a decimal string only when the run's money is settled (`complete`); null otherwise — the money is not final, never a fabricated zero.

types.name: RunOutcomeProof
types.doc: One completed run's proof coverage: required checks, passed checks and the clamped coverage ppm.

types.name: RunOutcomeChangeScale
types.doc: One completed run's changed-code scale.

types.name: RunOutcome
types.doc: One completed run's wire projection in the Engineering Outcome Ledger page: identity, acceptance/integration/verification verdict, model sequence, the LATEST settled money projection (`moneyState`), wall time, interventions, proof, change scale, rollback/recovery counters and the final verification basis. Engineering facts are immutable from record time; money fields are decimal strings only when `moneyState == "complete"` and null otherwise (a pending/unavailable money fact is never a fabricated zero). `avoidedHostedMicro` is null with `avoidedHostedMeasurement = "unavailable"` when no counterfactual authority exists. `verifiedFirstVerificationPass` is the run's FIRST VERIFICATION attempt having passed (a verification-attempt measure, never a first-implementation-attempt claim). `firstExecutionClass` / `finalExecutionClass` are the run's exactly-preserved boundary execution classes (the classification authority, independent of the bounded `modelSequence` folding; a pre-field payload falls back to the preserved sequence boundary — `unknown` when the authority is absent). `attributionState` reports `complete` | `partial` | `unavailable`: a non-complete attribution records the run but never fed its samples into the ledger's routing-learning feed (they kept the per-call feed).

types.name: OutcomeCursor
types.doc: The composite oldest-key cursor of one Engineering Outcome Ledger page (`nextCursor`); absent (null) when the page was not full.

types.name: OutcomesPage
types.doc: Response of GET /native/outcomes: the durable metrics fold plus one bounded newest-first page of completed-run projections and the composite cursor older pages continue from (null when exhausted).

types.name: ValueGovernanceCapabilities
types.doc: The value-entitlement report's governance capability picture (`governance`): `sso`/`scim` are capability vocabulary, effective only behind the `enterprise_governance` value entitlement (never an implementation).

types.name: ValueEntitlementDecision
types.doc: One per-entitlement value decision of the report: the entitlement tag, its typed enforcement hook, whether it is enforceable now and (only when not) the exact refusal cause. A granted decision omits `cause` (the schema field is optional).

types.name: ValueEntitlementsReport
types.doc: The caller organization's DERIVED value-entitlement report (`value_entitlements` member of GET /native/value-entitlements): the plan resolution, the plan-mapped inference-independent value tags, the effective governance capability flags and one typed decision per entitlement. The report never folds usage, credits or tokens.

types.name: ModelBinding
types.doc: One provider/model preference (plus optional reasoning effort).

types.name: PresetRoleModels
types.doc: The persisted per-role model map (planner/coder/verifier/summarizer).

types.name: PresetFallbackChain
types.doc: The ordered fallback candidates; order is authoritative.

types.name: CatalogProbe
types.doc: Observed reachability/model-list probe plus the served capability of one exact model.

types.name: McpAuthState
types.doc: Durable MCP auth binding; token material is never present.

types.name: ReviewComment
types.doc: A durable line-anchored review comment tied to session/task/change.

types.name: ChangeAcceptReceipt
types.doc: Idempotent per-file change acceptance: applied/already-current/rejected paths.

types.name: RestorePreviewFile
types.doc: One exact would-restore file action with current/expected/restored digests.

types.name: RestorePreview
types.doc: Dry-run restore plan; writes is always 0.

types.name: SessionExport
types.doc: Bounded exported session bundle with digest and redaction counts.

types.name: SessionSettings
types.doc: Per-session selectable compaction model and loop guards.

types.name: SessionDeleteTombstone
types.doc: Durable session deletion tombstone and the exact purged-row counts.
